## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |

| Depth | Interview + audit thoroughness | Light (3 interviews, desk audit) / Standard (6 interviews, competitive audit) / Deep (10 interviews, competitive + internal culture audit) | Deep blocked at Sprint pace |

| Pace | Calendar duration | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Deep (10 weeks) | Sprint blocks Deep depth and Full-system breadth |
| Format | Working mode | Async-only (Loom + docs) / Hybrid (workshops + async) / Live-heavy (all workshops in-person or synchronous) | Async-only blocks Deep depth |
| Support | Revisions + post-delivery | 1 round, no post-delivery / 2 rounds + 30-day office hours / Unlimited rounds + 90-day embed | 90-day embed requires Standard or Deep pace |
| Targeting | Market framing complexity | Single audience / Dual audience / Multi-segment or category creation | Multi-segment requires Deep depth |
| Add-ons | Discrete modules | Naming / Messaging playbook / Agency handoff doc / Launch playbook | Naming requires visual direction |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Full-system breadth
- Async-only + Deep depth
- Naming without visual direction
- 90-day embed on Sprint pace
- Multi-segment targeting without Deep depth

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light included · Standard +$3,000 · Deep +$7,000
- Breadth: Verbal included · + Visual direction +$4,000 · Full system +$10,000
- Pace: Sprint included · Standard +$1,500 · Deep +$4,000
- Format: Async included · Hybrid +$2,000 · Live-heavy +$5,000
- Support: 1 round included · 2 rounds + 30-day +$2,500 · Unlimited + 90-day embed +$8,000
- Targeting: Single included · Dual +$2,000 · Multi-segment +$5,000

**Add-ons (à la carte):**
- Naming: +$5,000 (requires visual direction)
- Messaging playbook: +$2,500
- Agency handoff doc: +$1,500
- Launch playbook: +$3,000

**Floor:** $6,500 — below this, route to a productized template or discovery call.
**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium ($32K is the better deal) or custom quote.

**Configurator-enforced dependencies:** all invalid combinations from Part 2.

**Flagship-protection check:**
- BYO-to-Core configuration: $6,500 + $3,000 (Standard depth) + $4,000 (Visual) + $1,500 (Standard pace) + $2,500 (2 rounds + 30d) = **$17,500** vs. Core flagship **$15,000** ✓

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |

| Format | Delivery + tracking | Spreadsheet / Coaching app / App + video library | — |
| Support | Response speed + revisions | Async 48hr, 1 revision/block / Async 24hr, unlimited revisions / Daily messaging, unlimited + form-checks | Daily messaging only available on Weekly pace |
| Add-ons | One-off enhancements | Monthly strategy call / Form-check pack (4/mo) / Supplement protocol / Travel-adaptive programming | Strategy call requires Bi-weekly or Weekly pace |
| **Commitment** *(domain-specific)* | Minimum term | 1 month / 3 months / 6 months | 6-month unlocks pricing discount; Premium tier requires 3-month minimum |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Monthly pace + unlimited nutrition adjustments (coach can't adjust what isn't checked in)
- Full meal plan without Nutrition pillar selected
- Daily messaging without Weekly check-ins
- Deep assessment without onboarding call scheduled in month 1
- 1-month commitment + 6-day advanced split (insufficient runway to progress the block)

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

| Tier | Configuration | Positioning | Pricing anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Lite — Self-Guided+** | Light depth · Training-only · Monthly check-in · App delivery · Async 48hr · 1-month min | For the disciplined client who needs a custom program and light accountability, not hand-holding | +$A/mo — anchored ~25–30% of your 1-on-1 rate; competes with template-app subscriptions ($50–150/mo) but with real customization |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** +$A/mo (Lite configuration)
- **Per-dimension upgrades:** each dimension level-up adds a fixed delta (e.g., Standard depth +$X, Weekly pace +$Y, Nutrition pillar +$Z, Daily messaging +$W)
- **Commitment discount:** 3-month prepay −10%, 6-month prepay −20%
- **Floor:** +$A/mo (Lite config, 1-month) — anything below isn't coaching, it's a template sale
- **Ceiling:** once BYO config sums above Premium's price, auto-route to Premium (they get more for less — but Premium remains the rational package, never undercut)
- **Dependencies the configurator must enforce:** all invalid combinations in Part 2, plus: if client selects Weekly + Daily messaging + Nutrition + Lifestyle, surface Premium as the better deal
- **Flagship-protection rule:** summing BYO upgrades to match Core's config must price ~15–20% *above* Core's flat rate; matching Premium's config via BYO must price ~25% above Premium. Flagships are always the rational discount for their configuration.

## What you probably want instead

**SKU + bundle logic**, which is a different discipline:

- **Variants** — leather type (vegetable-tanned, chromexcel, shell cordovan), color, stitch color, hardware
- **Configurations** — bifold / cardholder / long wallet / money clip; # of card slots; coin pocket y/n
- **Personalization** — monogram, custom embossing, gift packaging
- **Bundles** — wallet + belt, wallet + cardholder, his/hers sets
- **Tiers via materials** — Standard ($120, vegetable-tanned) / Signature ($180, chromexcel) / Heirloom ($350+, shell cordovan)

That's product-line architecture, not service productization.

## When intelligent-clay *would* apply to your business

If you added a **service layer** around the wallets, e.g.:

- **Custom commission service** — consult → design → handmade one-of-one wallet (service + product hybrid; I could decompose the service portion)
- **Leather repair / restoration service** — turnaround times, depth of restoration, materials matched
- **Workshops / teaching** — in-person or online classes on leatherwork
- **Corporate gifting program** — bulk customization, account management, recurring orders

Any of those, I can productize. The wallets alone — you need a different approach.
